important_rules: For dashboard and analytics requests, prioritize obt_* and dim_* tables over raw m* source tables.
Generated SQL must target PostgreSQL and should be executable against the public schema on port 3208.

Use dim_contact, dim_item, dim_item_warehouse_stock, dim_branch, dim_location, dim_warehouse, dim_coa, dim_terms, dim_division, dim_project, dim_cost_center, dim_department, dim_section, dim_country, dim_province, dim_city, dim_material, dim_model, dim_size, dim_type_sa, dim_item_permission, dim_transaction_note, and dim_item_transaction as the preferred descriptive dimensions for M1 master attributes.
When joining obt_sales_receivable.contact_id to dim_contact.contact_id, cast text contact_id using NULLIF(contact_id, '')::bigint.
Use dim_item_warehouse_stock when the user explicitly asks for stock per warehouse, warehouse availability, or item stock distribution across warehouses.
Use dim_item_transaction for mutation history, stock-card drilldown, and item movement snapshots when a canonical OBT is not a better fit.

For M3 inventory analytics, prefer obt_inventory_movement_line for TS, SP, and SA flows, and use dim_item_transaction plus dim_item_warehouse_stock for stock-card and warehouse balance style questions.

For M4 purchasing analytics, prefer obt_purchase_line_flow and obt_purchase_document_line_event for document lineage, and use obt_purchase_payment for advance, vendor payment, and payment proposal questions.
For M4 CS and PIE questions, prefer obt_purchase_comparative_event and obt_purchase_invoice_exchange_event; use dim_purchase_note and dim_purchase_attachment for auxiliary note/file requests.

For M5 sales analytics, prefer obt_sales_order_line_flow for SO-centered questions, obt_sales_line_flow for invoice-centered flow, and obt_sales_receivable for collection, voucher, and outstanding analysis.

For M5 SIE, SPA, CL, SF, notes, and files, prefer obt_sales_invoice_exchange_event, obt_sales_point_adjustment_event, obt_sales_closing_snapshot, obt_sales_forecast_event, dim_sales_note, and dim_sales_attachment.
For M6 manufacturing analytics, prefer obt_manufacturing_execution and obt_bom_route_snapshot; use dim_manufacturing_note and dim_manufacturing_attachment for note or file requests.
For M7 asset analytics, prefer obt_asset_lifecycle, obt_asset_depreciation_event, and obt_asset_mutation; use dim_asset_note and dim_asset_attachment for note or file requests.
For MR and RS header questions, prefer obt_inventory_request_event before attempting any raw M3 request tables.
For PA, RF, DC, RW, notes, and files, prefer dim_inventory_price_setup, dim_inventory_refuel_event, dim_inventory_daily_check, dim_inventory_rw, dim_inventory_note, and dim_inventory_attachment.

Do not query raw M3 source tables or M3 history tables from dashboards; if a requested M3 family is still source-empty in the canonical output, explain that the semantic output exists but is currently not populated.
Use dim_transaction_note and dim_transaction_note_detail for source-specific note vocabularies and transaction annotation lookup.
When computing aging from due_date, use CURRENT_DATE - due_date::date rather than subtracting timestamptz directly.
For cross-domain reconciliation, prefer joins by stable business keys such as contact_id, item_id, doc_no, and source_doc_type before using fuzzy lineage fields.
Use line-level OBT tables for item, quantity, account, and detailed flow analysis.
Use canonical finance tables for document mix and COA analysis; use cash receipt, cash disbursement, and receipt money tables for cash movement analysis.
For laba rugi or profit and loss questions, prefer obt_profit_loss_line and aggregate net_amount by pnl_category or pnl_group within the requested fiscal year or period.
Classify P&L from obt_profit_loss_line using pnl_category values REVENUE, COGS, OPERATING_EXPENSE, OTHER_INCOME, and OTHER_EXPENSE.
Do not assume every dashboard needs source-table fallback. Fail safely if the OBT query schema does not expose enough columns.
caution_areas: Several reconciliation use cases across finance and inventory rely on document-number bridges and may need additional business filters such as source_doc_type or date range.
Cross-table joins using doc_nos text aggregations like si_doc_nos are soft lineage hints and should be used conservatively.
Use explicit date casting or DATE_TRUNC in PostgreSQL when building time-series dashboards.
If a requested domain is not covered by the tables above, return FAILED rather than inventing raw-source joins.
